newsitem.title: USA: Northwest to offer half-price child fare.
newsitem.headline: Northwest to offer half-price child fare.

text.p: Northwest Airlines Corp said Wednesday it will immediately offer a 50 percent discount off most published fares for domestic and U.S.-Canada travel for children under two years of age traveling with an adult.
Northwest said it also offers discounts on U.S.-European and U.S.-Asia travel ranging from 25 to 50 percent.
The discounts apply to children occupying their own seats, and were implemented to support the use of child safety seats on airplanes, Northwest said.
The announcement follows earlier fare discounts made by AMR Corp's American Airlines and UAL Corp's United Airlines.

Current federal law permits children under two to be held by an adult during air travel, rather than purchase a separate seat for the infant. Northwest said that option remains available on all of its domestic flights.
